P-06.name: Frame member, 180 deep
P-06.notes: Web 20, outer flange 50 x 10 and seat lip 50 x 10 at z 170-180 (moved to the cabin face for the restack). Seam bolt holes 8.03 mm at 75 mm pitch at mid-depth (two per 150 mm D1 slice). Straight schematic: the real member's web leans 20.9 degrees to the joint plane.

P-01.name: Secondary rib segment, I 180 x 60 x 10, web 5
P-01.notes: Custom extrusion, 468.5 mm between flange ends, the web 10 mm longer at each end to bear in the node core slot. The node fork cheeks slide inside the section beside the web over the last 78 mm. 12 flange holes (two rows of three at 32 mm, rows 36 mm apart) and 6 web holes per end, 8.03 mm reamed for 5/16-24 A286 close-tolerance bolts. Inner-flange holes countersunk at the seat face (z 180).

P-02.name: Node star plate, 12 mm
P-02.notes: Two per node: one on the space side over the outer flanges, one inside the section under the inner flanges. Six arms 60 wide, 175 mm from the node centre. 6 holes per arm in two rows of 3 at 32 mm pitch.

P-03.name: Node web core, six forks
P-03.notes: Machined hexagonal core 90 mm across flats with six forks: 6 mm cheeks 90 mm long, 134 mm tall, with a 5.2 mm slot for the rib web. The cheeks sit inside the rib section between its flanges. 6 holes per fork, two columns of three, through both cheeks (double shear).

P-07.name: Pressure pane L7, 531 mm, 22 mm BOROFLOAT 33
P-07.notes: Equilateral 531 mm (k 4 cut, 9.09 mm short of each rib centre line). Corners truncated 60 mm for the node star plates and clamp screws. Edges ground and polished, 1 mm chamfers. Rests on the cabin face of the secondary rib inner flanges; pressure seats it.
P-07.source: Rev E restack (24 Oct), rib study (2 Nov)

P-14.name: Bolt 5/16-24 A286, NAS6705 family
P-14.notes: The seam bolt (NAS6705U27, grip 42.9 mm) and the node splice bolts (shorter grips) are the same family. Close tolerance shank in reamed holes.

P-04.name: Main rib, I 400 x 100 x 25, web 8, one piece with seat ledges
P-04.notes: Outer flange 100 x 25, web 8, seat ledges 30 mm each side at the seat plane z 170-180. The inner flange is the two bolted angles P-04A. 3/8-24 cap bolt holes through the web at 90 mm pitch, 40 mm below the cabin face. Length 2020 mm between hub and corner block (schematic ends).
P-04.source: Rev E restack (24 Oct), rib study (2 Nov)

P-04A.name: Main rib cap angle (one of two)
P-04A.notes: Two angles make the inner flange: horizontal leg 46 x 25 each (with the 8 mm web, 100 mm wide), vertical leg 100 x 12 down the web. Bolted horizontally through the web, 3/8-24 A286 close-tolerance in reamed holes, 90 mm pitch, after the glass is in.

P-05.name: Hub web core, six forks
P-05.notes: 160 mm core with six forks for the 8 mm main rib webs, 10 mm cheeks 150 long, 8 holes per fork (13 mm for 1/2-20 A286). Sits between the two hub star plates P-05A.

P-05A.name: Hub star plate, 25 mm
P-05A.notes: Two per hub, outer and inner. Six arms 100 wide, 25 thick, 10 holes per arm (13 mm, 1/2-20 A286). Carries each main rib's flange force straight across to the opposite rib.

P-08.name: Pane corner clamp at a node
P-08.notes: Holds the corners of the six pressure panes that meet at a node: a hexagonal plate 100 mm across flats, 6 mm thick, with a 2 mm elastomer pad and one M6 screw down through the inner flange and the star plate into the node core. Carries the pane's own weight on the ground, launch inertia and the seal seating force; never the pressure, which pushes the pane onto the flange. PROPOSAL, 2 Nov.

dims.screw: M6 x 40, A286, into the node core
dims.one_per: six-way node (18 per hexagon) plus the main rib and frame nodes

P-09.name: Seam bolt station with the spring stack (section through the two frame webs)
P-09.notes: The proposal of the 2 Nov seam bolt study: the NAS6705 bolt through the two 20 mm frame webs and two washers, with four Belleville discs (Inconel X-750, about 2.5 kN per mm as a stack) under a self-locking nut. The preload of 2.75 kN is set by the stack height, 1.10 mm of deflection, with a go/no-go gauge. The grooves in the lower web are the two butyl cord grooves. Mass is the metal in this 60 mm patch only.

dims.bolt: 5/16-24 A286 NAS6705, U, grip about 48.6 mm (NAS6705U33 or nearest)
dims.spring_stack: 4 Belleville discs in series, about 2.5 kN/mm
